parameters.body: The stone photograph and scalar fields share one analytic facade with window recesses, portal, pilasters and a carved rosette. This executable workflow is synthetic, not a demonstration of AI depth quality. Depth and coverage stay r32float data textures. Replace these three source nodes with your saved photograph and maps for a real facade.
parameters.title: Synthetic facade · registered RGB, depth and mask

parameters.body: switch_calibration1: 0 content, 1 regular test chart. Both pass through mask_surface1, gridwarp_surface1 and cornerpin_surface1. The preview shows that same warped branch over the reference photograph. Open window_projector1 explicitly to project it. Every stage remains editable.
parameters.title: Shared calibration and projector path

parameters.body: Contour engraving: depth_range → contours → Multiply with projection_tint → Level. Edit contour spacing and line width in wgsl_contours1, motion in lfo_photo_motion1, and colour/intensity in Solid and Level. The scalar depth creates lines through the carved relief instead of flat screen-space stripes.
parameters.title: Contour Engraving · editable stages
